what: A 1px vertical line sits at the left of the video slot — on interaction, while the video loads in place, an ink bar on the line shrinks and grows, blinking every .5s, and when ready it plays from the start, muted and looping, with the video turning on .25s late with no curve over the poster. While playing, the line fills ink-colored from the top by playback position, and the rotated vertical time text (current / length) sticks just under the fill and descends with it. On release it stops at once and returns to the start — the next interaction loads it again. On touch devices only the pressed slot plays

options.[data-fx-part=video]: Frame video (child) — <video muted loop playsinline preload="none" data-src="…">. On hover, put data-src into src, on release, remove it so it reloads on the next hover
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Video panel (child, position:relative, overflow:hidden) — holds the poster and the video. If absent, the video’s parent
options.time: When off, the time text is not drawn, default on
options.delay: Delay before the video turns on after playback starts (seconds), default 0.25
options.--fx-gap: Space between line and content (card left inner padding), default 40px
options.--fx-line: Stroke and fill color, default var(--kf-ink)
options.--fx-track: Color of the empty line during playback, default var(--kf-line)

use: Work Title
note: The original was a Vimeo player (loaded → play → immediately pause to read the length → rewind to 0 and play) — the same order <video> Stepped through this way. While scrolling, the panel can be made to ignore interaction until .5s has passed, so the consuming side may turn off pointer-events (original .scrolling)

from.where: index.html .mr-vb (all large · medium · small video frames) — original index__videoblock: bar__progress (#ccc 1px) · loading_progress .5s linear · embed opacity .00001 → 1 (.25s later) · bar__time max-height calc(100% − 4.1rem)
